generic_domain.justification: Disentanglement is a broad research domain in deep learning that involves separating out different factors or representations in data. It underpins various other domains such as unsupervised learning, generative models, and feature extraction. The concept of disentanglement is fundamental because it allows models to learn more interpretable and reusable features, which can then be applied across diverse tasks and applications, making it the most generic encompassing domain.
